title: Login Attempts Leak Across Different Users
description:
`AttemptTracker` in `attempts.py` should track failed login attempts **per user**, independently. `auth.py` locks a user out after 3 failed attempts. Right now, creating a new `AttemptTracker` still shows failed attempts recorded against a completely different tracker instance. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`attempts.py` — `AttemptTracker` records failures per username
`auth.py` — `is_locked_out(tracker, username)` checks the 3-attempt limit
